You are an independent reference labeller for a multi-agent pipeline audit. You see one checkpoint (the shared board) and a list of critical facts. Judge only the text shown; do not use outside knowledge; the final answer is not shown.

For every critical fact, decide whether the board carries the fact, and return the exact board unit ids whose text states it. A fact is carried when the union of the cited units states the fact's claim, allowing paraphrase, reordering and entity aliases, but not a different entity, value, date, relation or qualifier. A topic mention alone is not a carrier. If no unit states the claim, carried is "no" and unit_ids is empty.

Return strict JSON only:
{"facts": [{"fact_id": "...", "carried": "yes|no", "unit_ids": ["..."], "reason": "one short sentence"}]}
Every fact must appear exactly once.
